text: I love the Lord, for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.
I will call on him as long as I live.
the anguish of the grave came upon me; I was overcome by trouble and sorrow.
our God is full of compassion.
when I was in great need, he saved me.
for the Lord has been good to you.
my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,
in the land of the living.
for all his goodness to me?
and call on the name of the Lord.
in the presence of all his people.
is the death of his saints.
I am your servant, the son of your maidservant; you have freed me from my chains.
and call on the name of the Lord.
in the presence of all his people,
in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord.
